items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think he did a good job for the recording, helping to produce the recording.

ctx.x: Because what I’m trying to figure out is how – what led to making the album All the Way with Tommy LiPuma?

Actually, the attention came from the funeral. The attention came from the funeral, and they got together and got him. I think he did a good job for the recording, helping to produce the recording. I think Tommy did a good job.
